skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the principles and sources of international law, including treaties and customary international law.
Use internet resources to find legal sources, including treaties, customary international law, and court decisions.
Analyze legal issues and cases within the context of international law.
Prepare and present legal arguments and cases in a structured format.
Work in groups to solve legal problems and present findings.
Evaluate and select appropriate legal materials for research and presentations.
Plan and manage time effectively to prepare for exams and presentations.
Deliver clear and engaging presentations on legal topics.
Understand and apply negotiation techniques in resolving international disputes.
Identify and apply methods for resolving international disputes.
